_meta.description: Tier 2: Credit Control & Dunning Ladder. Declares seven new registers per ADR-024: DunningLadder (configuration of N-stage ladder per ondernemer/klantgroep), KlantLadderOverride (per-klant exception with motivatie + audit-trail), DunningRun (per-invoice per-stage execution log with evidence, immutable post-execute), IncassoKostenBerekening (BIK-staffel per Besluit BIK + wettelijke rente B2B/B2C per art. 6:119/6:119a BW), DunningPauseDispute (dispute-pause with optional 60-day hard deadline), CreditScore (optional Graydon/Creditsafe/Atradius Insights snapshot), OninbaarAfschrijving (write-off + BTW-teruggaaf per art. 29 OB). Per ADR-031 the BIK-staffel + rente calculations are captured as declarative x-openregister-aggregations on IncassoKostenBerekening; a thin PHP guard (BIKStaffelCalculator + DunningRunService + DunningPauseService) materialises the record when the OR aggregation engine cannot express the staffel arithmetic. Seed objects illustrate a 5-stage default ZZP ladder, overheid override, sample dunning run, BIK calc for €8.400, and sample dispute-pause.

DunningLadder.title: Dunning Ladder
DunningLadder.description: Configuration of a multi-stage dunning ladder per ondernemer or per klantgroep (DEFAULT, OVERHEID, VIP, AGGRESSIVE). Each stage declares dagenNaVervalDatum, kanaal (EMAIL / EMAIL+POSTREGISTRATIE / AANGETEKENDE_POST / INCASSOBUREAU_API), template reference (docudesk), and optional wettelijkEffect marker (14_DAGEN_BRIEF_BIK or VERZUIM_INTREDEN). One ondernemer MAY define multiple ladders. The active flag determines whether the ladder participates in automated dunning runs.

enterpriseId.description: Optional FK to the owning Administration / ondernemer. When null, the ladder applies tenant-wide within the administration scope.
enterpriseId.title: Onderneming ID

customerGroup.description: Customer cohort the ladder applies to. GOVERNMENT gets statutory 30-day terms per Wet betalingstermijnen overheid; VIP softens stage 4–5; AGGRESSIVE accelerates timing.
customerGroup.title: Klant Groep

stages.description: Ordered ladder stages. Each entry declares timing, channel, template, and optional wettelijkEffect marker.

daysAfterExpiryDate.description: Days after the invoice due date that this stage fires.
daysAfterExpiryDate.title: Dagen Na Verval Datum

templateId.description: FK to the docudesk template that renders subject + body for this stage.
templateId.title: Template ID

statutoryEffect.description: Optional legal effect marker. 14_DAYS_BRIEF_BIK triggers the mandatory B2C 14-day grace text (art. 6:96 lid 6 BW); DEFAULT_ENTRY marks formal default (verzuim van rechtswege).
statutoryEffect.title: Wettelijk Effect

action.description: Optional terminal action (e.g. TRANSFER_INCASSO at the overdraft stage).
action.title: Actie

stages.title: Stages

actief.description: Whether this ladder participates in automated dunning. Inactive ladders are kept for audit but skipped at run time.
actief.title: Actief

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. May be edited freely.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Superseded. Retained for audit; not used at run time.

activate.label: Activate ladder
activate.description: Publish the ladder so the scheduler may pick it up.

archive.label: Archive ladder
archive.description: Take the ladder out of rotation. Existing in-flight DunningRun records keep their snapshot of stages.

KlantLadderOverride.title: Klant Ladder Override
KlantLadderOverride.description: Per-klant exception on a base DunningLadder: overheid extended terms, VIP-skip stage 4/5, aggressive ladder for risk customers. Captures reden + createdBy/createdAt + approvedBy/approvedAt for audit-trail.

baseLadderId.description: FK to the DunningLadder this override layers on top of.
baseLadderId.title: Base Ladder ID

overrides.description: Override object. The 'stages' array replaces the base ladder's stages wholesale when present.

stages.description: Replacement stages array, same shape as DunningLadder.stages.
stages.title: Stages

overrides.title: Overrides

reason.description: Free-text motivation for the override. Required for audit-trail.
reason.title: Reden

createdBy.description: User id of the operator who created the override.
createdBy.title: Created By

approvedBy.description: User id of the controller / manager who approved the override. Required when the override modifies stage 4/5.
approvedBy.title: Approved By

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Authored but not yet in force.

active.label: Active
active.description: Applied at dunning-run time for the linked klant.

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.description: Replaced by a newer override or no longer applicable.

activate.label: Activate override
activate.description: Put the override into force. Stage 4/5 modifications require the role-gated approval guard.

supersede.label: Supersede override
supersede.description: Mark this override as superseded; a newer override or the base ladder takes effect.

DunningRun.title: Dunning Run
DunningRun.description: Per-invoice per-stage execution log with evidence trail (rendered subject/body, PDF SHA-256 hash, delivery status, optional digital signature, e-mail open tracking, PostNL barcode + delivery confirmation). Immutable once executed. Backs the proof-of-contact requirement of art. 6:96 BW.

invoiceId.description: FK to the ARInvoice / APTransaction UUID this run targets.
invoiceId.title: Factuur ID

ladderId.description: FK to the DunningLadder applied (after KlantLadderOverride resolution).
ladderId.title: Ladder ID

stageNr.description: Stage number (1–5 in the default ladder).
stageNr.title: Stage Nr

executedOn.description: Execution timestamp. Set when the run leaves the 'draft' lifecycle state.
executedOn.title: Uitgevoerd Op

channel.description: Delivery channel used for this stage.
channel.title: Kanaal

templateId.description: FK to the docudesk template used to render this run.
templateId.title: Template ID

renderedBody.description: Rendered body text (e-mail or letter). For B2C stage 3 MUST contain the verbatim 14-day grace text per art. 6:96 BW.
renderedBody.title: Rendered Body

renderedPdfHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the rendered PDF letter (proof-of-contact evidence).
renderedPdfHash.title: Rendered PDF Hash

openedAt.title: Opened At
openedAt.description: The date and time for opened at.

deliveredAt.title: Delivered At
deliveredAt.description: The date and time for delivered at.

digitalSignature.description: Optional digital signature over the rendered letter.
digitalSignature.title: Digital Signature

invoiceAmount.description: Invoice principal at the moment this run executed (EUR).
invoiceAmount.title: Factuur Bedrag

collectionCostAmount.description: Incasso costs at the moment this run executed (EUR). Set when the BIK-staffel has been computed.
collectionCostAmount.title: Incassokosten Bedrag

interestAmount.description: Wettelijke rente at the moment this run executed (EUR).
interestAmount.title: Rente Bedrag

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Composed but not yet dispatched. Subject/body/PDF may still be amended.

executed.label: Executed
executed.description: Dispatched to the channel. deliveryStatus reflects the outcome. Immutable from here on.

locked.label: Locked
locked.description: Sealed. No further amendments permitted (typically set once delivery is confirmed or the invoice moved to in_incasso).

execute.label: Execute dunning run
execute.description: Send via the configured kanaal. Captures uitgevoerdOp + deliveryStatus + evidence hashes. After this transition the record is immutable.

lock.label: Lock dunning run
lock.description: Seal the run: used when the invoice moves to in_incasso or written_off.

runsPerInvoice.label: Runs per invoice
runsPerInvoice.description: How many DunningRun records have been executed per invoice and stage. Drives aging/escalation dashboards.

deliveryByStage.label: Delivery by stage
deliveryByStage.description: Successful-delivery ratio per stage (DELIVERED / total). Powers the stage-funnel KPI.

IncassoKostenBerekening.title: Incasso Kosten Berekening
IncassoKostenBerekening.description: BIK-staffel + wettelijke rente computation per invoice. Implements the Besluit BIK staffel (15% / 10% / 5% / 1% / 0,5%, minimum €40, maximum €6.775 reached at €1.000.000) plus optional BTW-over-incassokosten (art. 2 lid 2 Besluit BIK, +21% when the creditor cannot offset VAT). Rente uses a maintained date-keyed rate table: handelsrente B2B per art. 6:119a BW (10,15% per 1-1-2026) or wettelijke rente B2C per art. 6:119 BW (4% per 1-1-2026); a window crossing a statutory rate boundary splits per sub-period. Recomputed on partial-payment against the remaining saldo.

principal.description: Principal at the time of calculation (EUR). After partial payment the calculation is re-run against the remaining saldo.
principal.title: Hoofdsom

calculation.description: BIK staffel breakdown. Five graduated slabs plus minimum-floor.

maximum.description: Statutory maximum per Besluit BIK (€6.775, reached at a €1.000.000 hoofdsom).
maximum.title: Maximum

applied.description: min(max(totaal, minimum), maximum): the normed fee excl. BTW.
applied.title: Toegepast

vatOffsettable.description: True when the creditor can offset the VAT on the collection service (no surcharge). When false, art. 2 lid 2 Besluit BIK adds BTW to the fee.
vatOffsettable.title: BTW Verrekenbaar

vatPercentage.description: VAT percentage applied to the fee when btwVerrekenbaar is false (0 otherwise).
vatPercentage.title: BTW Percentage

vatAmount.description: BTW surcharge on the incassokosten (art. 2 lid 2 Besluit BIK); 0 when the creditor can offset VAT.
vatAmount.title: BTW Bedrag

appliedInclVat.description: toegepast + btwBedrag: the incassokosten actually owed.
appliedInclVat.title: Toegepast Incl BTW

calculation.title: Berekening

rate.description: Headline annual rate as decimal (the rate in force on berekendOp). Per 1-1-2026: 0.1015 B2B handelsrente, 0.04 B2C wettelijke rente. Resolved from the maintained date-keyed rate table.
rate.title: Tarief

effectiveDate.description: Date the rente started to accrue (day 0 for B2B / day 44 for B2C).
effectiveDate.title: Ingangsdatum

amount.description: Total rente in EUR: sum over per-rate sub-periods of (hoofdsom × tarief × dagen / 365), rounded to cents.
amount.title: Bedrag

periods.description: Per-rate accrual sub-periods (audit trail). A window crossing a statutory rate boundary splits so each sub-period accrues at its own rate.
periods.title: Perioden

van.description: First day of this accrual sub-period (inclusive). Equals the parent ingangsdatum for the first sub-period, and the statutory rate-change date for every later one.
van.title: Van

tot.description: Last day of this accrual sub-period (inclusive). Equals the day before the next statutory rate change, or the parent berekendOp for the final sub-period.
tot.title: Tot

days.description: Whole days accrued in this sub-period (van.tot inclusive). The sub-period dagen sum to the parent dagen.
days.title: Dagen

rate.description: Annual statutory rate in force during this sub-period, as a decimal (0.1015 = 10,15%). Per art. 6:119a BW for B2B handelsrente or art. 6:119 BW for B2C wettelijke rente.
rate.title: Tarief

amount.description: Interest accrued in this sub-period in EUR: hoofdsom x tarief x dagen / 365, rounded to cents. The sub-period bedragen sum to the parent bedrag.
amount.title: Bedrag

statutoryRente.title: Wettelijke Rente
statutoryRente.description: A structured wettelijke rente object with nested per-rate sub-periods.

partyType.description: Counterparty type: controls the rente rate and the B2C 14-day grace block.
partyType.title: Party Type

bikStaffel.label: BIK staffel
bikStaffel.description: Declarative shape of the Besluit BIK staffel arithmetic (per). The PHP BIKStaffelCalculator produces an identical record when the OR aggregation engine cannot express the multi-slab expression directly.

renteAccrual.label: Rente accrual
renteAccrual.description: Declarative shape of the wettelijke rente accrual. For B2B uses HANDELSRENTE_B2B_6_119A_BW (ECB+8pp → 10,15% per 1-1-2026); for B2C uses WETTELIJKE_RENTE_B2C_6_119_BW (4% per 1-1-2026). Rates are resolved from a maintained date-keyed table; the BIKStaffelCalculator PHP guard splits a boundary-crossing window per sub-period.

DunningPauseDispute.title: Dunning Pause / Dispute
DunningPauseDispute.description: Pause registration on a dunning ladder for a specific invoice. Halts further DunningRun stage actions and IncassoKostenBerekening rente accrual. Resolved either by operator action or by the auto hard-deadline (default 60 days after pauzeStart).

pauseEnd.description: When the pause ended. Null = still paused.
pauseEnd.title: Pauze Eind

pausedBy.description: User / actor id who initiated the pause.
pausedBy.title: Gepauzeerd Door

evidenceRefs.description: FK URIs to docudesk or openregister evidence records (e-mails, dispute correspondence).
evidenceRefs.title: Evidence Refs

active.label: Active
active.description: Pause is in force; no dunning runs may execute for the linked invoice and no rente accrues.

resolved.label: Resolved
resolved.description: Operator marked the dispute resolved or a partial settlement was reached. Ladder resumes from the stage where the pause began.

hardDeadlineExpired.label: Hard deadline expired
hardDeadlineExpired.description: The configured deadline elapsed without resolution; ladder auto-resumes.

resolve.label: Resolve dispute
resolve.description: Mark the dispute resolved (e.g. partial settlement). Sets pauzeEind.

expire.label: Hard deadline expired
expire.description: Reached hardDeadlineEindigt without operator action; ladder auto-resumes.

CreditScore.title: Credit Score
CreditScore.description: Optional external credit-score snapshot per klant (Graydon, Creditsafe, Atradius Insights). Cached for dunning.credit_score_cache_days days (default 30) to limit lookup cost. Triggers a UI warning when the score falls below the configured threshold.

score.description: Numeric score on the provider-specific scale.
score.title: Score

paymentRiskIndication.title: Betalings Risico Indicatie
paymentRiskIndication.description: The date and time for betalings risico indicatie.

active.label: Active
active.description: Within the cache window; usable at invoice-creation time.

stale.label: Stale
stale.description: Older than dunning.credit_score_cache_days; refresh required before use.

markStale.label: Mark stale
markStale.description: Mark the snapshot stale once the cache window elapses.

OninbaarAfschrijving.title: Oninbare Afschrijving
OninbaarAfschrijving.description: Definitive write-off + BTW-teruggaaf voorbereiding per art. 29 OB. Captures hoofdsomAfgeschreven, btwBedrag, art29OBVerklaring (e.g. 'Faillissement', 'Schuldsanering', '1 jaar onbetaald'), evidence ref (faillissementsvonnis / WSNP-besluit), GL boekingId, and the BTW-aangifte period the teruggaaf is queued for.

vatAmount.description: VAT amount eligible for teruggaaf per art. 29 OB (EUR).
vatAmount.title: BTW Bedrag

art29OBDeclaration.description: Reason / declaration (e.g. 'Faillissement vonnis 2026-04-12', 'Schuldsanering WSNP', '1 jaar onbetaald').
art29OBDeclaration.title: Art29Ob Verklaring

evidenceRef.description: FK URI to the supporting docudesk evidence (faillissementsvonnis, schuldsaneringsverzoek, etc.).
evidenceRef.title: Evidence Ref

entryId.description: FK to the materialised GLTransaction recording the write-off.
entryId.title: Boeking ID

vatTaxReturnPeriod.description: VAT filing period the teruggaaf has been queued for (e.g. '2026-Q2').
vatTaxReturnPeriod.title: BTW Aangifte Periode

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Operator proposed the write-off; GL posting + BTW teruggaaf not yet materialised.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: GL posting materialised, BTW teruggaaf queued, invoice flipped to written_off.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Write-off retracted (rare). Requires compensating GL entry.

post.label: Post write-off
post.description: Materialise the GL posting + queue BTW teruggaaf for the next aangifte period. Implements.

void.label: Void write-off
void.description: Reverse the write-off; requires a compensating GLTransaction.

objects.renderedBody:
Geachte Crediteurenadministratie Acme BV,

Uw factuur 2026-0247 van €8.400 staat sinds 2026-05-14 open. U krijgt 14 dagen om de factuur alsnog te voldoen zonder dat incassokosten of rente verschuldigd worden. Na deze termijn kunnen incassokosten en wettelijke rente verschuldigd zijn.

Met vriendelijke groet,
De ondernemer

objects.details: Klant betwist 4 uur uit week-22; gesprek gepland 10 juni
